recommendation.headline: Fight the unauthorized transaction chargeback with delivery confirmation, recipient signature, customer messages, and established purchase history.
recommendation.rationale: The buyer filed an unauthorized transaction claim (chargeback) despite having a verified delivery with a signature by E ORTIZ at the exact shipping address, prior positive messages confirming receipt, and five previous successful transactions with Laceline Resale. The overwhelming delivery and communication evidence gives us an extremely high probability of winning this dispute.

recommendation.response_to_paypal: This transaction is fully authorized and legitimate. The item was shipped to the buyer's verified address (9 Harbor Rd, Portland, ME 04101) via USPS Priority Mail with signature confirmation and was delivered on October 17, 2026, signed for by E ORTIZ. Furthermore, the buyer messaged us directly confirming receipt ('They arrived and they're perfect, thank you!'). The buyer also has a history of five successful prior purchases with our shop shipped to this exact address. We respectfully request that PayPal/the card issuer uphold this charge.
